## v0.4.0 — 2026-11-12
- Add SenseVoice on-device live captions, with installation and repair from Settings or CLI.\ 新增 SenseVoice 本地实时字幕，可从设置或 CLI 安装、验证与修复模型。 - Keep translation work across caption reconnects and setting changes; complete missing translations after restart as a separate version.\ 字幕重连或切换设置时保留翻译任务，重启后可补齐缺失译文并保存为独立版本。 - Generate editable meeting notes with version history and citations back to the transcript and audio, using local or BYOK text models.\ 支持用本地或自备 Key 的文字模型生成可编辑会议纪要，保留版本历史，引用可定位到原文与录音。 - Confirm names, terms, aliases, and translations for one recording or the whole library.\ 支持确认人名、术语、别名与译名，可应用于单份录音或整个资料库。 - Show per-source recognition and translation timing, request states, and local runner CPU and memory in the App, CLI, and Markdown export.\ App、CLI 与 Markdown 导出统一展示分音源识别及翻译耗时、请求状态，以及本地识别进程的 CPU 与内存开销。 - Keep long captions on the latest words in the compact window, preserve full history, and convert Chinese captions to the selected script.\ 小窗长字幕跟随最新文字，保留完整历史，并按所选简繁体显示中文字幕。 - Finish local-caption connections after stopping so exports and normal App shutdown can complete.\ 修复停止录音后本地字幕连接无法收尾、进而阻塞导出或正常退出的问题。 - Report an error when local MOSS decoding exhausts its generation budget instead of publishing repeated text as a successful transcript.\ 本地 MOSS 解码耗尽生成额度时明确报错，不再将重复文本作为成功转写结果。

## v0.3.0 — 2026-11-06
- Start with a guided sample, recording permissions, and model setup. Skip setup when ready, or reopen it from General settings.\ 首次使用可分步体验示例、了解录音权限并配置模型；可稍后设置，也可从通用设置重新进入。 - Keep pending model and recording preferences in sync between onboarding and Settings.\ 首次引导与设置窗共享未保存的模型和录音偏好，切换入口继续编辑。 - Read earlier captions without new content pulling you to the bottom. A new-caption hint takes you back to the latest text and resumes following.\ 回看历史字幕时保留阅读位置；出现新内容时轻提示，点击回到最新并恢复跟随。 - Remember the caption window position for each display and keep restored windows within the visible screen area.\ 按显示器记忆字幕窗位置，重开恢复时保持窗口处于屏幕可见区域。
Local builds, automated checks, and native UI verification are documented in the [first-use](docs/verification/first-use.md) and [caption-window](docs/verification/caption-window.md) records, including remaining hardware checks.\ 本地构建、自动化检查和原生界面验收见[首次使用](docs/verification/first-use.md)与[字幕窗](docs/verification/caption-window.md)记录，包含待补的实机检查。

## v0.2.3 — 2026-11-03
- Reduce runaway repetition in local Qwen transcription with a mild repetition penalty and a generation budget based on audio duration.\ 为本地 Qwen 转写加入轻度重复惩罚，并按音频时长限制生成长度，减少异常复读。 - Report an error when Qwen exhausts its generation budget, preserve completed chunks and diagnostics, and let you retry from the unfinished chunk.\ Qwen 耗尽生成额度时明确报错，保留已完成分块与诊断信息，可从未完成的音频块继续重试。
